title: The Principal Upanishads
subtitle: Selected texts from the foundational Vedantic scriptures
translator: Public-domain translations (Max Müller / Sri Aurobindo, modernised)
description: The Upanishads are the concluding portion of the Vedas, expounding the philosophy of Brahman and Atman. This collection presents three of the principal Upanishads with Sanskrit and English.

chapters.title: Katha Upanishad (excerpts)
chapters.placeholderNote: Only the opening of Valli I is included. The full Katha Upanishad spans 6 vallis with 119 mantras; remaining text will be added in a future update.
